airport.name: Dr. Luciano de Arruda Coelho Regional Airport

summary: Dr. Luciano de Arruda Coelho Regional Airport (JSO) serves the city of Sobral in the northern part of Ceará state, northeastern Brazil. As a medium-sized regional facility, it primarily handles domestic flights connecting Sobral to larger hubs such as Fortaleza. The airport is named after a local figure and plays an important role in supporting business and tourism travel in the northern Ceará region.
faqs:
Q: What is the IATA code for Dr. Luciano de Arruda Coelho Regional Airport?
A: The IATA code is JSO.

Q: Which city does this airport serve?
A: It serves the city of Sobral in the state of Ceará, northeastern Brazil.

Q: What types of flights operate from JSO?
A: The airport primarily handles regional domestic flights, mainly connecting Sobral to major Brazilian hubs such as Fortaleza.

Q: Is JSO an international airport?
A: No, it is a regional domestic airport serving primarily intrastate and limited interstate routes.
transport_tips: The airport is located a short drive from central Sobral, making taxis and rideshare services the most convenient ground transport options. Rental cars can also be arranged locally for travelers exploring the broader Ceará region. There is no direct rail or metro service to the airport, so road transport is essential.
local_tip: Frequent visitors recommend arriving early during the rainy season (February to May), as brief tropical downpours are common in the afternoon and can occasionally affect flight schedules. Keeping a light rain jacket handy is a smart move when traveling through JSO.
